mutations.defect: a <script> tag, so the page no longer ships zero JS
a CTA pointing at a host that cannot resolve
a 2000px fixed-width element, far wider than the 375px viewport
body copy at #bbbbbb on white, under the AA contrast floor
an em dash in rendered copy
one digit removed from a tel: href while its label still reads correctly
a tel: href written with spaces, so the digits match but the URI is malformed
an embedded image large enough to push the page past its byte budget
an image placeholder left in the src, so the page renders a broken image
the brief's accent hex replaced everywhere by a nearby darker tone
an entrance start state with no animation to bring it back, so the text never appears
content removed entirely under prefers-reduced-motion instead of just its motion

knownBlindSpots.defect: a claim in the copy that appears nowhere in the brief, such as the drafter's invented "the keys stay with you" and "no term, no penalty"
knownBlindSpots.whyMissed: checking a sentence against a brief is a judgement, not a comparison; nothing deterministic can decide it
knownBlindSpots.caughtBy: the advisory review pass, which is why that pass exists
